items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did have some friend that we had in the band. One was Thomas Badger

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Let’s see now. Who was the Badger? The Badger. That’s what we called him. The Badger. I can’t remember exactly. We did have some friend that we had in the band. One was Thomas Badger, and also Bill Pennick.
Because this group has Alerta Hampton.
